destination.title: Gravitational entropy: origins, bounds, dynamics and applications
destination.question: How is gravitational entropy defined, counted and constrained, and what can its thermodynamics imply under specified physical assumptions?
destination.summary: No original scientific scope was supplied beyond candidate numerical membership. The usable family includes competing entropy interpretations and ordinary pre-Swampland work. Membership does not establish a universal area-law derivation, species cutoff, entropy bound or cosmological interpretation.

systems: Quantum fields, localized systems and particle towers
targets: Definitions and microscopic interpretations of entropy
Entropy bounds and generalized second-law consistency
Quantum entropy dynamics and geometric constraints
Thermodynamic response and conditional quantum-gravity applications
regimes: Classical, semiclassical and proposed microscopic descriptions, kept distinct
Source-specific dimensions, asymptotics and coupling limits
assumptions: Each source's assumptions apply locally; numerical proximity supplies none
Conjectures, open questions and additional consistency postulates remain conditional
conventions: Species number, graviton occupation number and algebraic large N are distinct
Thermodynamic, entanglement, relative, generalized and fine-grained entropies are not interchangeable
Fixed quantities, observer choices and entropy normalizations remain source-specific
includes: Ordinary black-hole thermodynamics and historical entropy-bound debates
Nongravitational comparisons relevant to entropy and information
Alternate access to adjacent energy-condition and stability questions
excludes: Treating all facets as one scoped scientific question
Treating source-object settings or claims as verified question premises
Promoting proposed cosmological or observational implications to established results

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Does classical positive null energy suffice to make holographic subsystem entropy increase throughout a general gravitational collapse, and does that behavior survive Hawking-radiation corrections? The source proposes the broader behavior without supplying a general proof.

sources.title: Black Hole Bound on the Number of Species and Quantum Gravity at LHC

evidence.text: How does a large number of particle species constrain their mass scale and the gravitational cutoff, and could those constraints explain the weak/Planck hierarchy and require unusual microscopic black-hole decay patterns?

sources.title: Black Hole Entropy and Gravity Cutoff

evidence.text: Can black-hole entanglement entropy reproduce the universal Bekenstein–Hawking area law despite its apparent dependence on the number of particle species, once the gravitational cutoff depends on that number?

sources.title: Quantum Information and Gravity Cutoff in Theories with Species

evidence.text: Can limitations on species information storage, detection and quantum cloning independently motivate the species-dependent gravity cutoff, and can matching black-hole validity thresholds illuminate field-theory/gravity correspondence?

sources.title: Effective field theory, large number of particle species, and holography

evidence.text: How does adding many particle species to an effective QFT with holographic UV/IR mixing change the entropy of near-collapse systems, constrain the species count and permit entanglement entropy to match black-hole entropy?

sources.title: A proof of the Bekenstein bound for any strength of gravity through holography

evidence.text: Can the GCEB-motivated minimum thermodynamic length imply the Bekenstein entropy bound at arbitrary gravitational strength, when energy and radius are unambiguous, and constrain viscosity and species proliferation?

sources.title: Bounds on Black Hole Entropy in Unitary Theories of Gravity

evidence.text: In weakly coupled unitary extensions of Einstein gravity, does semiclassical black-hole entropy exceed the number of light species, and is Einstein entropy minimal at fixed mass? The paper also investigates analogous AdS black-brane entropy-density statements.

sources.title: Black Hole's Quantum N-Portrait

evidence.text: Can black-hole classicality, Hawking radiation, entropy and proposed gravitational UV self-completion be described through the graviton occupation number N, with geometric quantities emerging at large N?

sources.title: Pseudotopological quasilocal energy of torsion gravity

evidence.text: The wedge construction asks whether a gravitational charge reproduces the distinguishability of a deformed boundary state from a reference state. It separates an outer modular-energy contribution from an inner entropy contribution.

sources.title: Outer Entropy and Quasilocal Energy

evidence.text: Can outer entropy be calculated for nonspherical normal surfaces by maximizing an interior HRT area with fixed exterior geometry, and can that coarse-grained entropy define a positive, inclusion-monotonic quasilocal energy?

sources.title: Quantum Penrose Inequality

evidence.text: Can the classical Penrose lower bound on total mass survive quantum matter, and can generalized entropy on an appropriate quantum lightsheet replace area to give a semiclassical relation between total energy and quantum information?

sources.title: Bag-of-gold spacetimes, Euclidean wormholes, and inflation from domain walls in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Which inflating bubbles and bag-of-gold geometries can be prepared by asymptotically locally AdS Euclidean path integrals, and can arbitrarily large interiors occur at fixed exterior black-hole entropy?

sources.title: Black Hole as a Quantum Field Configuration

evidence.text: Can semiclassical gravity and quantum matter provide a self-consistent evaporating black-hole interior, explain its supporting pressure and energy loss, and reproduce the entropy area law by counting field configurations?

sources.title: Quantum Gravity in Species Regime

evidence.text: Can a large number of particle species isolate collective and nonperturbative quantum-gravity effects while suppressing other corrections, and clarify black-hole/de Sitter depletion, entanglement and quantum breaking?

sources.title: Finiteness and the swampland

evidence.text: Can finite black-hole entropy and finite quantum-gravity partition functions provide a common rationale for the Weak Gravity Conjecture, Distance Conjecture, and suitably defined finiteness of vacua?

sources.title: Large N algebras and generalized entropy

evidence.text: Can generalized black-hole entropy emerge as the statistical entropy of an explicit large N operator algebra using Lorentzian physics, and can algebra inclusions explain a controlled case of the generalized second law?

sources.title: On black hole thermodynamics, singularity, and gravitational entropy

evidence.text: How are black-hole thermodynamics and microstructure connected to singularities, cosmic censorship and curvature-based gravitational entropy? Can Hookean and Ruppeiner descriptions illuminate differences between black holes in different gravitational theories?

sources.title: Partition Function for a Volume of Space

evidence.text: Can a gravitational partition function count states of a topological ball at fixed proper spatial volume, and does its leading saddle yield boundary-area entropy for zero, positive or negative cosmological constant?

sources.title: From entropy to echoes: Counting the quasi-normal modes and the quantum limit of silence

evidence.text: Can thermally weighted quasi-normal-mode counting account for black-hole entropy, and can near-horizon dissipation connect an area-law entropy to gravitational-wave echo times?

sources.title: Species entropy and thermodynamics

evidence.text: Can particle species and their gravitational cutoff admit thermodynamic quantities analogous to minimal black holes, providing an entropic interpretation of swampland constraints?

sources.title: Entropy bounds and the species scale distance conjecture

evidence.text: Can the Covariant Entropy Bound explain the geodesic and exponential features of the Swampland Distance Conjecture, constrain species-scale decay rates, and yield a condition preserved under dimensional reduction?

sources.title: Black hole from entropy maximization

evidence.text: Can maximizing thermodynamic entropy at fixed boundary area characterize a quantum black hole and determine a self-consistent interior without assuming either a horizon or the Bekenstein-Hawking formula?

sources.title: Emergence of species scale black hole horizons

evidence.text: Can integrating out the light tower associated with a small black hole's infinite-distance core connect three meanings of the species scale: the species-counting cutoff, the onset of higher-derivative corrections, and the inverse radius of the smallest EFT-describable black hole?

sources.title: Mapping 1$+$1-dimensional black hole thermodynamics to finite volume effects

evidence.text: Can finite-volume vacuum effects in scalar QFT and static black-hole thermodynamics exhibit analogous null-energy and entropy behavior under a∝T⁻¹, despite their different physical settings?

sources.title: Entropy and spectrum of near-extremal black holes: semiclassical brane solutions to non-perturbative problems

evidence.text: Why does gravitational entropy become negative near extremality, and can semiclassical gravity compute a thermodynamically meaningful quenched entropy when the topological expansion fails?

sources.title: Entanglement and local holography in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can string theory supply a gravitational Hilbert-space factorization and bulk entanglement entropy that reproduces extremal-surface areas at low energy, despite gravitational constraints and the absence of diffeomorphism-invariant spatial subregions?

sources.title: A short overview on the Black Hole-Tower Correspondence and Species Thermodynamics

evidence.text: Can black-hole entropy be related to the microscopic entropy of weakly coupled towers at the species cutoff, and can thermodynamic consistency constrain the allowed towers? This proceedings review summarizes the proposed Black Hole–Tower correspondence and Species Thermodynamics.

sources.title: Can gravitational-wave data shed light on dark matter particles?

evidence.text: Can imposing an additional sign-based consistency criterion on logarithmic black-hole entropy corrections translate historical gravitational-wave area-theorem results into restrictions on matter species, including axion dark-matter candidates?

sources.title: Thermodynamic split conjecture and an observational test for cosmological entropy

evidence.text: Do controlled string-theoretic black-hole entropy constructions justify the same observer-independent microstate interpretation for cosmological horizons, and can tomographic information proxies test a proposed cosmological area scaling?

sources.title: Cosmological implications of thermodynamic split conjecture

evidence.text: If black-hole and cosmological horizon thermodynamics are generically inequivalent, how would replacing Gibbons–Hawking thermality and area entropy affect inflation, vacuum transitions, horizon-based cosmological dynamics, and possible explanations of H0 and S8 tensions?

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Compare the radial metric factor with its pure-AdS value pointwise, then test the subtracted radial integral at zero and infinity. The explicit convergence conditions are added in the analytical reconstruction.

sources.title: Black Hole Bound on the Number of Species and Quantum Gravity at LHC

evidence.text: For relativistic species in a box, use E ∼ NT4L3 and S ∼ NT3L3, restrict L by gravitational collapse, and impose S ≲ MP²L². A separate cosmological argument compares radiation temperature with the FRW horizon temperature.

sources.title: Black Hole Entropy and Gravity Cutoff

evidence.text: Define reduced density matrices by partial tracing and entropy by S_A = −Tr(ρ_A log ρ_A). Local short-distance correlations motivate a regulated leading horizon-area term; purity gives S_A = S_B.

sources.title: Quantum Information and Gravity Cutoff in Theories with Species

evidence.text: The Alice–Bob experiment uses Rindler horizon coordinates, the singularity condition and uncertainty-limited signaling energy. The correspondence argument matches UV/IR black-hole thresholds and uses Kaluza–Klein relations between Planck scales.

sources.title: Effective field theory, large number of particle species, and holography

evidence.text: The cosmological estimate uses ρ_Λ≈ρ_rad0 a⁻³, L≈M_Pl ρ_rad0⁻¹/²a^(3/2), and T∝a⁻¹ to evaluate the maximum species count at reheating. These are model-specific asymptotic relations, rather than a general cosmological evolution law.

sources.title: A proof of the Bekenstein bound for any strength of gravity through holography

evidence.text: Partition matter into locally equilibrated concentric shells and bound ratios of sums by sums of positive shell ratios. Apply the local minimum-length condition, then use p≤ρ to obtain the entropy-to-energy bound.

sources.title: Black holes and entropy

evidence.text: How can black-hole area acquire the meaning and dimensions of entropy, and how should the second law account for ordinary entropy disappearing behind a horizon?

sources.title: Relative entropy and the Bekenstein bound

evidence.text: Can the Bekenstein bound receive an unambiguous flat-space QFT formulation using localized, vacuum-subtracted entropy and modular energy, and does that formulation follow from semiclassical generalized-second-law arguments without an additional physical principle?

sources.title: de Sitter Black Holes, Schottky Peaks, and Continuous Heat Engines

evidence.text: Do ordinary positive-Λ black-hole thermodynamic systems exhibit Schottky-like specific-heat peaks, and can their two-temperature dynamics support continuous heat engines constrained by the second law?

sources.title: Black holes and entropy

evidence.text: Can a black hole assist a process that converts heat completely into work and thereby violates the second law?

sources.title: The Volume of black holes

evidence.text: Can stationary spacetimes admit a thermodynamically meaningful volume independent of stationary slicing, and can discrete identifications produce bounded horizon area with unbounded volume? The latter question motivates a conditional discussion of the statistical interpretation of black-hole entropy.

sources.title: IR/UV mixing, towers of species and swampland conjectures

evidence.text: Which AdS region makes an entropy comparison sensitive to the cosmological scale? The paper fixes the box radius at order the AdS radius, between locally flat small spheres and large spheres with comparable area-volume growth.

sources.title: Black hole entropy as entanglement entropy: A Holographic derivation

evidence.text: Can black hole entropy be identified entirely with quantum-field entanglement across the horizon while accounting for ultraviolet dependence, the species problem, and gravitational backreaction?

sources.title: Hawking area law in quantum gravity

evidence.text: What restrictions on local and nonlocal higher-curvature gravity follow if merger-motivated Hawking area increase is postulated to be exact, and what consequences follow for Wald entropy and multifractal black-hole geometry?

sources.title: A Covariant entropy conjecture

evidence.text: Can Bekenstein’s entropy/area bound be extended covariantly to strongly gravitating and cosmological regions by selecting suitable null hypersurfaces instead of arbitrary spatial interiors?

sources.title: Entropy bounds and black hole remnants

evidence.text: Does accounting for Unruh–Wald buoyancy preserve a GSL-based entropy bound, and can species proliferation, additional spatial dimensions, or information-storing black hole remnants evade it?

sources.title: The entropy of Hawking radiation

evidence.text: How can gravitational fine-grained entropy methods compute Hawking-radiation entropy consistently with unitary evaporation, despite the growing entropy obtained from the semiclassical radiation state?

sources.title: Gravitational wave constraints on corrections to Bekenstein-Hawking Area Formula in classical F(R) gravity and quantum GR : implications for theory parameters

evidence.text: Can gravitational-wave analyses supporting the Hawking Area Theorem constrain small additive corrections to black-hole entropy, and thereby F(R) parameters or quantum-field species, when combined with the generalized second law and an additional sign criterion?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture for the Effective Field Theories with N Species

evidence.text: Can an N-species relativistic gas be heated above the species gravity scale while remaining a bounded, noncollapsed thermodynamic system?

sources.title: Black holes and entropy

evidence.text: Does capture of a maximum-entropy light beam preserve generalized entropy, and how do fluctuations limit such a test?

sources.title: Proof of the Weak Gravity Conjecture from Black Hole Entropy

evidence.text: Under what assumptions do higher-dimension operators increase black-hole entropy at fixed mass and charge, and can the resulting coefficient bounds enforce a positive extremality shift and the weak gravity conjecture?

sources.title: Black holes and entropy

evidence.text: Can a candidate entropy functional survive a merger that loses information while radiating some of the initial energy?

sources.title: Nature of Microscopic Black Holes and Gravity in Theories with Particle Species

evidence.text: What properties of microscopic black holes and short-distance gravity follow from unitarity and consistency with macroscopic black-hole physics in theories with N particle species, without specifying microscopic gravity or assuming extra dimensions?

sources.title: Black hole entropy and induced gravity

evidence.text: What information accounts for black hole entropy, and can the same quantum fluctuations explain both horizon entanglement and the gravitational coupling appearing in A/(4ħG), including its dependence on matter species?

sources.title: Black holes and entropy

evidence.text: How can a second law remain meaningful for an exterior observer when a body carrying ordinary entropy disappears through a horizon?

sources.title: String Landscape and the Standard Model of Particle Physics

evidence.text: Can black-hole entropy supply a relative weighting of flux vacua beyond counting solutions?

sources.title: A Bound on the effective gravitational coupling from semiclassical black holes

evidence.text: Can a consistent classical modification of Einstein gravity permit semiclassical black holes smaller than the species scale, or does semiclassical black-hole existence impose a universal upper bound on the effective gravitational coupling above the ultraviolet cutoff?

sources.title: Entropy, Entanglement and Swampland Bounds in DS/dS

evidence.text: Does an entropy defined on the entire spatial slice have to fit within the information capacity of one static-patch observer?

sources.title: Tests of restricted quantum focusing and a new CFT bound

evidence.text: Does restricted quantum focusing survive where the original QFC fails, and can a new nongravitational limit of rQFC predict constraints stronger than QNEC?

sources.title: Black holes and entropy

evidence.text: Can a black hole serve as an entropy sink that converts all supplied heat into work through lowering and retrieval?

sources.title: IR/UV mixing, towers of species and swampland conjectures

evidence.text: What entropy can an EFT assign to a finite region before gravitational restrictions invalidate its extensive state count? The baseline comparison uses the original fields and leaves tower entropy out.

sources.title: A Few words on entropy, thermodynamics, and horizons

evidence.text: Are proposed Bekenstein and holographic entropy bounds necessary for semiclassical black-hole thermodynamics, and how does observer-dependent entropy flux resolve apparent generalized-second-law violations?

sources.title: Infinite Black Hole Entropies at Infinite Distances and Tower of States

evidence.text: Which degrees of freedom become light when a black hole horizon and its entropy grow without bound? The investigation relates a distance between background metrics to internal compactification modes and to excitations connecting black hole microstates.

sources.title: Thermodynamic topology of black holes and an invariant of spacetime

evidence.text: Can black-hole thermodynamic topology be constructed directly from physical thermodynamic variables without auxiliary Θ, and can an asymptotic limit of the resulting flux characterize the background spacetime?

sources.title: A Note on Gauge Theories Coupled to Gravity

evidence.text: Can semiclassical charged-black-hole discharge and entropy bounds justify the proposed AMNV lower bound on gauge coupling in asymptotically flat spacetime dimensions D ≥ 4, and what survives for non-Abelian and discrete symmetries?

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: How does the entanglement entropy of a fixed-width boundary interval respond to homogeneous gravitational collapse? A prescribed null-time-dependent Vaidya mass permits this question without requiring an explicit field-theory construction of the evolving state.

sources.title: Gravitational positive energy theorems from information inequalities

evidence.text: Can positivity and monotonicity of boundary quantum relative entropy yield gravitational subsystem energy bounds and necessary consistency conditions on asymptotically AdS geometries?

sources.title: On the Topology and area of higher dimensional black holes

evidence.text: Extend Hawking-type horizon topology restrictions and topology-dependent lower area or entropy bounds to higher dimensions, using positive scalar curvature and the σ-constant in place of the two-dimensional genus.

sources.title: Microscopic Origin of Page Curve

evidence.text: Which degrees of freedom within a gravitational theory account for black-hole Wald entropy and the entanglement underlying the Page curve? The paper seeks to identify their Hamiltonian phase-space origin rather than add unspecified microstates to the theory.

sources.title: Black Hole Quantum Mechanics in the Presence of Species

evidence.text: Does the black-hole species bound survive finite-occupation-number quantum hair, and how does the nature of species affect the lightest black holes and the possibility of gravitational self-UV-completion?

sources.title: Heat and work in black hole thermodynamics via holography

evidence.text: How can black hole thermodynamics incorporate externally driven work, heat exchange with baths and nonequilibrium entropy through quantum thermodynamics and AdS/CFT, without varying the underlying microscopic theory?

sources.title: Entropy Bound and Unitarity of Scattering Amplitudes

evidence.text: How do area-law and inverse-coupling entropy bounds follow from scattering unitarity, how do they differ from the Bekenstein bound, and what characterizes objects saturating them?

sources.title: Black holes and entropy

evidence.text: The common geometric setting expresses horizon area and mechanical changes in terms of externally accessible mass, charge, and angular momentum.

sources.title: Thermodynamic Origin of the Null Energy Condition

evidence.text: Can a local thermodynamic interpretation of gravitational entropy yield the pointwise classical Ricci convergence condition R_μνv^μv^ν≥0, thereby supplying a gravitational origin for the classical null energy condition?

sources.title: Gravity and the crossed product

evidence.text: How do perturbative gravitational corrections change the emergent large-N algebra outside an eternal black hole, and permit a definition of black hole entropy?

sources.title: Area Law Saturation of Entropy Bound from Perturbative Unitarity in Renormalizable Theories

evidence.text: Does saturation of information-storage bounds acquire an area-law form in nongravitational renormalizable field theories, and is this tied to the boundary of perturbative unitarity?

sources.title: The Volume of 2-D black holes

evidence.text: How should a slicing-invariant volume for stationary black holes extend to two-dimensional dilaton gravity, and can a black hole have infinite volume while retaining finite area without pathological global structure?

sources.title: The Shortest scale of quantum field theory

evidence.text: Can QFT with many species, a Minkowski vacuum and gravitating vacuum fluctuations remain consistent up to Planckian momenta? Does a species-dependent ultraviolet cutoff help reconcile QFT with black-hole entropy constraints?

sources.title: Infinite Black Hole Entropies at Infinite Distances and Tower of States

evidence.text: Horizon area provides a macroscopic entropy against which geometric distances and microscopic excitation scales can be compared. The number of black hole microstates grows exponentially with this entropy.

sources.title: A Note on the Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: What can a simple many-species thermal system say about entropy constraints when the actual light-tower entropy is inaccessible? The surrogate is a noncollapsing relativistic gas in a sphere, with gravitational interactions otherwise neglected.

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Which NEC violations threaten the measurement and entropy arguments? The paper singles out stable propagating clock sectors that can approach non-gravitation, distinguishing them from quantum effects and projected objects that do not provide the same measuring apparatus.

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Does the proposed covariant entropy increase as a collapsing bulk black hole represents thermalization of a boundary state?

sources.title: On Page's examples challenging the entropy bound

evidence.text: Do Page’s confined-field counterexamples, low-temperature states, and proliferation-of-species argument violate S ≤ 2πER when E includes the gravitating energy of every essential system component?

sources.title: The Smeared Null Energy Condition

evidence.text: Is there a state-independent lower bound on null energy averaged over a finite affine interval, without introducing entanglement entropy, that restricts negative-energy backreaction in theories consistently coupled to gravity?

sources.title: Black Shells, Dirac's Field and the species problem

evidence.text: Can a collapsing thin-shell description supply a physical near-horizon cutoff, reproduce Bekenstein–Hawking entropy from a Dirac thermal atmosphere, and remove the species dependence when scalar and spinor contributions are combined?

sources.title: On the origin of species thermodynamics and the black hole - tower correspondence

evidence.text: Can ordinary thermodynamics explain the species constitutive relations and area scaling, constrain admissible towers, and parametrically account for Schwarzschild black-hole entropy through a black hole–tower correspondence?

sources.title: Black hole entropy from near horizon microstates

evidence.text: Can black-hole entropy be obtained by counting excitations of a locally AdS3 near-horizon region, using general gravitational symmetry and conformal-state asymptotics without requiring string theory or supersymmetry?

sources.title: Generalized gravitational entropy

evidence.text: Can Euclidean gravitational entropy be defined without a circle-translation Killing symmetry, and can a gravitational replica construction explain why the entropy is given by a codimension-two minimal-surface area?

sources.title: Species and Strings

evidence.text: Can semiclassical black-hole evaporation and gravitational limits on species resolution explain effective string-species counting, black-hole entropy bounds, and their continuation into the strong-coupling M-theory limit?

sources.title: The Holographic principle

evidence.text: What general relation between surface area and information survives the failure of spatial entropy bounds, and does that relation reveal fundamental degrees of freedom of quantum gravity?

sources.title: Black hole entropy is the Noether charge

evidence.text: In general Lagrangian gravity, can the first-law horizon term be written as κ/(2π) times the variation of a local geometrical entropy, and how does that entropy relate to Noether charge, dynamical horizons and Euclidean methods?

sources.title: Black holes and entropy

evidence.text: Does adding an area-dependent black-hole entropy preserve a second-law inequality when ordinary entropy disappears through the horizon?

sources.title: Why the entropy of spacetime is independent of species of particles -- the species problem

evidence.text: How can Bekenstein–Hawking entropy remain independent of the number of radiated particle species if all those species contribute to a black-hole atmosphere? The authors offer a proposed resolution by identifying spacetime entropy with atmosphere entropy.

sources.title: Dimensional reduction in quantum gravity

evidence.text: What restrictions do unitary black hole physics and entropy counting place on microscopic quantum-gravity degrees of freedom, and can local discrete models realize the resulting surface encoding while retaining nontrivial dynamics and the required symmetries?

sources.title: Universal relations with the non-extensive entropy perspective

evidence.text: Does the thermodynamic relation between entropy corrections and the extremal mass bound survive replacing Bekenstein–Hawking entropy by five nonextensive entropy prescriptions for a charged AdS black hole? Can an entropy-dependent multiplicative factor restore it?

sources.title: Notes on space-time thermodynamics and the observer dependence of entropy

evidence.text: How do inertial and uniformly accelerated observers assign entropy to the same localized object with n internal states, especially at large n, and what does the difference imply for generalized-second-law arguments and proposed entropy bounds?

sources.title: Penrose Inequality as a Constraint on the Low Energy Limit of Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can an apparent horizon carry more entropy than any stationary AdS black hole at the same mass in a holographically consistent gravity theory?

sources.title: Distance and de Sitter Conjectures on the Swampland

evidence.text: How can an entropy-compatible tower produce a dark-sector mass spacing? The source assumes evenly spaced levels and a cutoff between N^−1/2 and the Planck scale, then illustrates the scaling at R∼10^60.

sources.title: Bekenstein bounds in de Sitter and flat space

evidence.text: Can a Bekenstein-type entropy bound hold beyond asymptotically flat space, and how do its scope and tightness relate to the holographic bound S ≤ A/4, particularly in dimensions greater than four?

sources.title: Hartle-Hawking wave-function for flux compactifications

evidence.text: Can complete spatial flux compactification define a Hartle–Hawking-type state on moduli and flux sectors, identify that state with the topological string, and give a physical weighting related to black-hole entropy?

sources.title: Notes on quantum corrections of swampland and trans-Planckian censorship conjectures

evidence.text: How are the refined conjecture's Hessian branch and explicit higher-dimensional compactifications changed by quantum entropy effects? The paper leaves these questions open and does not infer a Hessian constraint from its modified null-energy-condition slope calculation.

sources.title: Lorentz violation and perpetual motion

evidence.text: Can black-hole thermodynamics, particularly the generalized second law, survive Lorentz violation with multiple propagation speeds, once equilibration and ergoregion instabilities are considered?

sources.title: Black holes and uptunneling suppress Boltzmann brains

evidence.text: Within the scale-factor cutoff measure, can black-hole nucleation and localized up-tunneling prevent Boltzmann-brain domination, and how would localized high-energy daughter regions alter vacuum probabilities?

destinations.title: Does classical positive null energy suffice to make holographic subsystem entropy increase throughout a general gravitational collapse, and does that behavior survive Hawking-radiation corrections? The source proposes the broader behavior without supplying a general proof.

How does a large number of particle species constrain their mass scale and the gravitational cutoff, and could those constraints explain the weak/Planck hierarchy and require unusual microscopic black-hole decay patterns?

Can black-hole entanglement entropy reproduce the universal Bekenstein–Hawking area law despite its apparent dependence on the number of particle species, once the gravitational cutoff depends on that number?

Can limitations on species information storage, detection and quantum cloning independently motivate the species-dependent gravity cutoff, and can matching black-hole validity thresholds illuminate field-theory/gravity correspondence?

How does adding many particle species to an effective QFT with holographic UV/IR mixing change the entropy of near-collapse systems, constrain the species count and permit entanglement entropy to match black-hole entropy?

Can the GCEB-motivated minimum thermodynamic length imply the Bekenstein entropy bound at arbitrary gravitational strength, when energy and radius are unambiguous, and constrain viscosity and species proliferation?

In weakly coupled unitary extensions of Einstein gravity, does semiclassical black-hole entropy exceed the number of light species, and is Einstein entropy minimal at fixed mass? The paper also investigates analogous AdS black-brane entropy-density statements.

Can black-hole classicality, Hawking radiation, entropy and proposed gravitational UV self-completion be described through the graviton occupation number N, with geometric quantities emerging at large N?

The wedge construction asks whether a gravitational charge reproduces the distinguishability of a deformed boundary state from a reference state. It separates an outer modular-energy contribution from an inner entropy contribution.

Can outer entropy be calculated for nonspherical normal surfaces by maximizing an interior HRT area with fixed exterior geometry, and can that coarse-grained entropy define a positive, inclusion-monotonic quasilocal energy?

Can the classical Penrose lower bound on total mass survive quantum matter, and can generalized entropy on an appropriate quantum lightsheet replace area to give a semiclassical relation between total energy and quantum information?

Which inflating bubbles and bag-of-gold geometries can be prepared by asymptotically locally AdS Euclidean path integrals, and can arbitrarily large interiors occur at fixed exterior black-hole entropy?

Can semiclassical gravity and quantum matter provide a self-consistent evaporating black-hole interior, explain its supporting pressure and energy loss, and reproduce the entropy area law by counting field configurations?

Can a large number of particle species isolate collective and nonperturbative quantum-gravity effects while suppressing other corrections, and clarify black-hole/de Sitter depletion, entanglement and quantum breaking?
Can finite black-hole entropy and finite quantum-gravity partition functions provide a common rationale for the Weak Gravity Conjecture, Distance Conjecture, and suitably defined finiteness of vacua?

Can generalized black-hole entropy emerge as the statistical entropy of an explicit large N operator algebra using Lorentzian physics, and can algebra inclusions explain a controlled case of the generalized second law?

How are black-hole thermodynamics and microstructure connected to singularities, cosmic censorship and curvature-based gravitational entropy? Can Hookean and Ruppeiner descriptions illuminate differences between black holes in different gravitational theories?

Can a gravitational partition function count states of a topological ball at fixed proper spatial volume, and does its leading saddle yield boundary-area entropy for zero, positive or negative cosmological constant?
Can thermally weighted quasi-normal-mode counting account for black-hole entropy, and can near-horizon dissipation connect an area-law entropy to gravitational-wave echo times?
Can particle species and their gravitational cutoff admit thermodynamic quantities analogous to minimal black holes, providing an entropic interpretation of swampland constraints?

Can the Covariant Entropy Bound explain the geodesic and exponential features of the Swampland Distance Conjecture, constrain species-scale decay rates, and yield a condition preserved under dimensional reduction?

Can maximizing thermodynamic entropy at fixed boundary area characterize a quantum black hole and determine a self-consistent interior without assuming either a horizon or the Bekenstein-Hawking formula?

Can integrating out the light tower associated with a small black hole's infinite-distance core connect three meanings of the species scale: the species-counting cutoff, the onset of higher-derivative corrections, and the inverse radius of the smallest EFT-describable black hole?
Can finite-volume vacuum effects in scalar QFT and static black-hole thermodynamics exhibit analogous null-energy and entropy behavior under a∝T⁻¹, despite their different physical settings?
Why does gravitational entropy become negative near extremality, and can semiclassical gravity compute a thermodynamically meaningful quenched entropy when the topological expansion fails?

Can string theory supply a gravitational Hilbert-space factorization and bulk entanglement entropy that reproduces extremal-surface areas at low energy, despite gravitational constraints and the absence of diffeomorphism-invariant spatial subregions?

Can black-hole entropy be related to the microscopic entropy of weakly coupled towers at the species cutoff, and can thermodynamic consistency constrain the allowed towers? This proceedings review summarizes the proposed Black Hole–Tower correspondence and Species Thermodynamics.

Can imposing an additional sign-based consistency criterion on logarithmic black-hole entropy corrections translate historical gravitational-wave area-theorem results into restrictions on matter species, including axion dark-matter candidates?

Do controlled string-theoretic black-hole entropy constructions justify the same observer-independent microstate interpretation for cosmological horizons, and can tomographic information proxies test a proposed cosmological area scaling?

If black-hole and cosmological horizon thermodynamics are generically inequivalent, how would replacing Gibbons–Hawking thermality and area entropy affect inflation, vacuum transitions, horizon-based cosmological dynamics, and possible explanations of H0 and S8 tensions?

Can black-hole thermodynamic topology be constructed directly from physical thermodynamic variables without auxiliary Θ, and can an asymptotic limit of the resulting flux characterize the background spacetime?

Which degrees of freedom within a gravitational theory account for black-hole Wald entropy and the entanglement underlying the Page curve? The paper seeks to identify their Hamiltonian phase-space origin rather than add unspecified microstates to the theory.

What restrictions on local and nonlocal higher-curvature gravity follow if merger-motivated Hawking area increase is postulated to be exact, and what consequences follow for Wald entropy and multifractal black-hole geometry?

Can gravitational-wave analyses supporting the Hawking Area Theorem constrain small additive corrections to black-hole entropy, and thereby F(R) parameters or quantum-field species, when combined with the generalized second law and an additional sign criterion?
Does accounting for Unruh–Wald buoyancy preserve a GSL-based entropy bound, and can species proliferation, additional spatial dimensions, or information-storing black hole remnants evade it?

What restrictions do unitary black hole physics and entropy counting place on microscopic quantum-gravity degrees of freedom, and can local discrete models realize the resulting surface encoding while retaining nontrivial dynamics and the required symmetries?

Extend Hawking-type horizon topology restrictions and topology-dependent lower area or entropy bounds to higher dimensions, using positive scalar curvature and the σ-constant in place of the two-dimensional genus.

Can complete spatial flux compactification define a Hartle–Hawking-type state on moduli and flux sectors, identify that state with the topological string, and give a physical weighting related to black-hole entropy?

Can stationary spacetimes admit a thermodynamically meaningful volume independent of stationary slicing, and can discrete identifications produce bounded horizon area with unbounded volume? The latter question motivates a conditional discussion of the statistical interpretation of black-hole entropy.
Can black hole entropy be identified entirely with quantum-field entanglement across the horizon while accounting for ultraviolet dependence, the species problem, and gravitational backreaction?
How can black-hole area acquire the meaning and dimensions of entropy, and how should the second law account for ordinary entropy disappearing behind a horizon?

destination.title: Conditional matter and distance bounds in DS/dS
destination.question: Within proposed DS/dS holography, when can comparisons of entanglement with horizon entropy constrain matter deformations or scalar and geometric displacement?
destination.summary: A usable conditional question. Entropy reproduction, an assumed ceiling and a distance-conjecture interpretation require separate assessments.

systems: D-dimensional geometries with d=D−1 de Sitter slices
Two cutoff CFT sectors coupled to lower-dimensional gravity
targets: Validity of global versus static-patch entropy comparisons
regimes: Explicit D=4 free massless scalar example
assumptions: Specified entanglement is subject to a proposed horizon-entropy ceiling
The thesis's quantitative inequality is not supplied
conventions: The displacement example includes the warp-maximum modulus A(0)
A bounded A(0) projection does not by itself establish a bound on every trajectory length
includes: Testing the ceiling and its tracing domain
excludes: An independently established exclusion of all matter
Automatic equivalence of the thesis criterion and other DS/dS inequalities
